validation.upgrade: The development-only older updater and production 1.6.0 installs preserved the original notebook bytes exactly.
validation.notes: Three flows pass on the packaged 1.6.0 APK. They cover settings navigation, real GitHub latest-release checks, portrait/landscape captures, connection failure/retry, cancellation, checksum/signature/version validation, restored verified downloads, read-only content URI grants, exclusion of diary paths, and tamper rejection without changing notebook bytes. A fourth flow uses this updater built with version 1.5.1/code 13 to download the real public 1.5.2 APK, verify it, open Android install-source settings, receive a development-emulator permission grant, hand off to the system installer, and return after cancellation. Final installation is left to Android/user confirmation; it was not automated. The unrelated signing key and next-version APK are test-only files and are not included in the release. No physical Honor phone test was performed.
